recent_news.headline: How Grease Trap Services Work: Environmental Septic's Guide to Kitchen Drain Management
recent_news.summary: Overview of grease trap operations, maintenance requirements, and compliance with environmental regulations. Covers how grease traps prevent pipeline blockages and protect septic systems and municipal wastewater treatment.

recent_news.headline: ServiceCore Named Best Overall Portable Sanitation Software for 2026; Grease, Septic, and Liquid Waste Operators Consolidate Dispatch, Route Optimization, and Billing
recent_news.summary: ServiceCore released updated guidance positioning its platform as purpose-built software for grease, septic, and portable sanitation operators, emphasizing route optimization, 28-day billing cycles, and compliance features integrated into a single system.

backfill_news.headline: Electric Truck Adoption in Waste Fleets Hinges on Business Case as Regulations Fade; Over 40% of Garbage Trucks Expected to Be Zero-Emission by 2026
backfill_news.summary: Report highlights that despite regulatory changes, electric and alternative-fuel garbage trucks are gaining adoption driven by total cost of ownership and sustainability goals, with Volvo previewing next-generation VNL Electric for waste collection applications.
